title: Hard-coded error messages need custom error types
description: JournalWriter.swift:39 uses generic NSError with hard-coded domain. Poor error diagnostics, difficult debugging. Create proper custom error types for better error handling.

title: Legacy NSString usage not Swift 6.2 compliant
description: Bot.swift:18,32 and TextHandler.swift:45 use 'as NSString).appendingPathComponent()' instead of modern Swift URL APIs. Not Swift 6.2 compliant, potential encoding issues. Use URL.appendingPathComponent() instead.

title: API key exposure risk in configuration
description: Configuration handling has no explicit security measures to prevent API key logging/exposure. Potential credential leakage. Ensure secrets are not logged, consider encrypted storage.

title: Missing test coverage for core Bot logic
description: No tests for Bot.swift and main application flow. Critical bot functionality is completely untested, high risk of regressions. Add comprehensive tests for bot message handling and error scenarios.

title: Fix race condition in JournalWriter appendToJournalFile method
description: Critical race condition in JournalWriter.swift:29-52 where multiple messages can cause data loss. The appendToJournalFile method performs non-atomic read-modify-write operations without synchronization. Two messages arriving simultaneously can read the same file state, then overwrite each other's entries. Need to implement file locking, atomic operations, or message queue to prevent data corruption.

title: Add dependabot configuration for automated dependency updates
description: Setup dependabot.yml to automatically create PRs for Swift package dependency updates with auto-merge enabled for minor/patch versions

title: Add basic validation for API key and user ID fields
description: Validate API key is non-empty after trimming, user ID is positive integer > 0

title: Add comprehensive tests for configuration validation scenarios
description: Extend ConfigReaderTests with validation edge cases, error message verification, path validation scenarios

title: Update copilot instructions for auto-merge workflow
description: Replace incorrect beads instructions with proper stylus-telegram-bot project instructions including auto-merge workflow guidelines

title: Create PR template with auto-merge checklist
description: Add GitHub PR template with checklist for auto-merge requirements including CI passing, code review, and proper formatting

title: Configure auto-merge requirements in repository settings
description: Setup GitHub repository settings to require CI checks, reviews, and enable auto-merge feature for qualifying PRs

title: Add status checks requirement for CI workflow
description: Ensure GitHub Actions workflow names are properly configured as required status checks for branch protection

title: Critical: Bot crashes on any error with fatalError
description: Bot.swift:56 uses fatalError() when server stops, terminating entire process. No recovery mechanism. Replace with proper error handling, logging, and restart logic.

title: Implement Knowledge Base path validation logic
description: Validate KB path exists/writable, not system directory, proper permissions for journals subdirectory creation

title: Missing configuration validation
description: ConfigReader.swift has no validation of configuration values (file paths, API keys, user IDs). Runtime failures with invalid configurations. Add comprehensive validation in config reading.

title: Replace print() with proper logging framework
description: Throughout codebase uses print() instead of proper logging framework. Poor production debugging, no log levels or structured logging. Implement swift-log for structured logging.

title: Add custom ConfigValidationError types for better error messages
description: Create ConfigValidationError enum with specific cases for path validation, API key validation, user ID validation. Replace generic NSError usage with meaningful error messages.

title: Update existing ConfigReaderTests to handle new error types
description: Ensure existing tests still pass with new validation errors, update error expectations as needed

title: Critical: Synchronous API calls block main loop
description: Bot.swift:21 uses nextUpdateSync() instead of async variant, blocking main thread. Bot becomes unresponsive during network delays. Fix: Use nextUpdate() with async/await pattern.

title: Race condition in DateFormatter usage
description: DateFormatter.swift:12-22 has DateFormatter that is not thread-safe but used in actor without proper isolation. Potential crashes or incorrect formatting under concurrent access. Create new DateFormatter instances per call or ensure proper actor isolation.

title: Update readConfig function to use new validation logic
description: Integrate custom validation into readConfig function while maintaining backward compatibility

title: Setup semantic versioning and automated releases
description: Add automated release workflow using semantic-release or similar tool to automatically create releases when PRs are merged to main

title: URL regex vulnerability in LinkProcessor
description: LinkProcessor.swift:22-27 has incorrect while loop that always returns after first iteration, doesn't handle all punctuation properly. Links not properly cleaned, potential injection issues. Fix while loop logic and add comprehensive punctuation handling.

title: Critical: Infinite loop with no graceful shutdown
description: Bot.swift:21-55 creates infinite while loop with no exit strategy. Cannot stop bot gracefully, causes resource leaks. Add signal handlers for graceful shutdown and timeout mechanisms.

title: Setup GitHub branch protection rules for auto-merge
Fix firewall blocking tuist.dev in CI/build process
description: Firewall rules are blocking access to tuist.dev during Swift build process in CI/PR environments. This prevents proper builds and needs to be resolved by either configuring Actions setup steps before firewall activation or adding tuist.dev to the custom allowlist in repository Copilot coding agent settings.
